# Zenserp

Zenserp is a real-time SERP API that extracts Google Search results in JSON format.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/zenserp/.

## Actions

- **Bing Search**: Obtain bing search results.
- **Google Maps Search**: Perform a google maps (local) search.
- **Google News Search** (read-only): Perform a google news search.
- **Google Reverse Image Search**: Perform a reverse image search on google.
- **Google Shopping Search** (read-only): Perform a google shopping search.
- **Google Shopping Search**: Perform a google shopping search.
- **Google Trends** (read-only): Retrieve google trends data.
- **Google Video Search** (read-only): Perform a google video search via zenserp.
- **Yandex Search via Zenserp**: Obtain yandex search results via zenserp api.
- **Zenserp Google Image Search**: Perform a google image search via zenserp.
- **Zenserp Google Search**: Perform a standard google search via zenserp.
